reader.structural_contract: WorkersAIReader plus deeply frozen metadata; unchanged logical DecisionRequest and DecisionResult
reader.binding: Mandatory lowercase SHA256 expected digest must match the actual frozen vault reader before transport. A well-shaped mismatch returns DECISION_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED.
reader.configuration_digest: SHA256 of captured endpoint/model allowlists, requested model, configured revisions, effective context, confidence profile, request/response/deadline limits, artifact attestation, metadata, provenance and live permission. Opaque logical IDs do not select endpoints.
reader.provenance: fixtureTransport construction fixes synthetic_wire_fixture; absent fixtureTransport fixes live_test_unqualified. Supplied flags cannot relabel either.
reader.secret: Existing SecretVault credential, Bearer header only. No new credential or account registry.

wire.endpoint: exact canonical approved HTTPS URL with path /v1/systemone; no query, fragment, userinfo, redirect, path inference or runtime discovery
wire.model: Exact trusted model_id explicitly sent; successful reported model must equal that selected model, even if another model is separately allowlisted.
wire.questions: noul keeps type/instructions; choice maps logical options to criteria; score maps logical levels to criteria
wire.response_envelope: raw SystemOne response, not Cloudflare success/result or OpenAI chat output
wire.normalization: Preserve full probabilities and reported confidence through the existing strict decision validator. Check exact answer membership, types and score legends; reject unknown fields and business actions.
wire.usage: Complete finite nonnegative safe-integer input_tokens/output_tokens are preserved, including zero. Absent/null usage or a missing/null token count becomes unknown usage:null, never zero. Malformed known values or unknown usage fields are rejected.
wire.revision: Wire does not report revision; logical serving.revision remains null. Configured model/serving revisions are distinct metadata, not provider observations.
wire.error_handling: Fixed DECISION_* failures only; no provider body, token, response headers or redirect destination returned.

limits.effective_context_tokens: Required trusted declaration, 1024 through 16384; this is not an observed tokenizer or deployed context qualification.
limits.request_limit_rule: Default is min(8192,effective_context_tokens-512); trusted capability overrides can only narrow. Validate complete logical and encoded wire bodies; never truncate state.
limits.deadline: One finite race covers fetch and bounded body read; cancellation is nonblocking and late aborted output cannot become usable.

confidence_profiles.sglang_systemone_adapter_v1: Local descriptor for SGLang's System One adapter formulas, not calibrated correctness. Preserve the received statistic; do not transfer thresholds from another backend.
confidence_profiles.clef_reference_top_probability_v1: Local descriptor for the reference implementation's top-option probability as choice/score confidence. Preserve its separate identity and configured revision.
confidence_profiles.normalizer: Checks finite [0,1] bounds without recomputing confidence from probabilities or claiming formula/backend conformance from a supplied profile.

readiness.complete: Known Clef repository matches model_id; nonempty configured revisions and effective context match attestation; all named SHA256 pins exist; both load claims are true.
readiness.missing: Explicit list of absent, invalid or mismatched evidence fields
readiness.attestation_digest: Hash of supplied claims, or null; no authentication or runtime observation is inferred.
readiness.actual_qualification: Requires separately authorized observed deployed loader/model/head/tokenizer/serving pins, effective context/no-truncation evidence, frozen-cohort backend observations and current independent qualification/publication.
